facts.text: Caroline attended an LGBTQ support group on 7 May 2023.

evidence.quote: I went to a LGBTQ support group yesterday and it was so powerful.

facts.text: Caroline found the transgender stories shared at the support group to be inspiring.

evidence.quote: The transgender stories were so inspiring! I was so happy and thankful for all the support.

facts.text: Caroline reported feeling accepted and courageous as a result of attending the support group.

evidence.quote: The support group has made me feel accepted and given me courage to embrace myself.
